transcript: Here are three ways to start letting go of your past in the next 30 days. Number one, stop asking why it happened. That question will keep you trapped for years. Start asking, what did it teach me? Because the moment you find the lesson, you stop being the prisoner of the pain. Number two, forgive the version of you that did not know better. You made decisions with the mind you had back then, with the fear you had back then, with the knowledge you had back then. So stop punishing your old self with the wisdom you only have today. Number three, remember this, the past is a teacher. It is not your home. You can visit it for wisdom, but you cannot live there anymore. Take the lesson, leave the weight, and keep walking because your future needs you much more than your past does. And if you are ready to stop carrying the same pain every day, I put together a 30-day healing journey for you. It is in the link on my profile.
